evidence_states.verified: Source or reviewed control flow establishes this claim for the exported server revision.
evidence_states.conditional: The claim is supported and its known condition or branch is shown.
evidence_states.configured_estimate: A configured value is shown with its runtime-modifier caveat.
evidence_states.source_clue: A source reference suggests a relationship but its player-accessible path is unreviewed.
evidence_states.not_reviewed: Relevant source exists, but its behavior has not been semantically reviewed.
evidence_states.unknown: The value is unavailable, dynamic, or not extracted; give a reason when known.

counting_policy: Counts describe exported records or explicitly named subsets, not completeness of player-facing explanations. Clues, reviewed facts, configured values, and runtime observations are separate states.

skill_trigger_translations.basis: configured monster skill records with documented trigger state, condition, chance, and target semantics

configured_drop_coverage.basis: monster records with at least one configured drop row

static_spawn_coverage.basis: monster records with at least one loaded static spawn placement

script_spawn_coverage.basis: monster records with at least one indexed script-spawn clue

translated_effects.basis: records with a supported natural-language effect summary

noncard_translated_effects.basis: non-card item records with a supported natural-language effect summary

drop_sources.basis: records linked to at least one configured monster drop

literal_shop_sources.basis: records linked to at least one literal loaded shop offer

container_sources.basis: records linked to at least one indexed container outcome

translated_effects.basis: card records with a supported natural-language effect summary

drop_sources.basis: records linked to at least one configured monster drop

translated_combo_effects.basis: distinct combo records with translated script summaries

icon_rows_linked_to_server_status.basis: status icon rows with one or more server status mechanics linked

quest_records_with_hunt_targets.basis: quest records with at least one exported hunt target

quests_with_reviewed_flow.basis: quest records with source-anchored reviewed flow notes

reviewed_npc_stage_relations.basis: NPC-stage relations with an authored reviewed role

verified_quest_item_rewards.basis: nearby literal item-grant candidates whose complete quest branch was manually reviewed

quests_with_verified_item_rewards.basis: quest records with at least one source-reviewed item reward

map_known_declarations.basis: declarations whose map identifier resolves in the static map index

reviewed_service_roles.basis: distinct service roles cited by source-reviewed exchange records

reviewed_service_records.basis: source-reviewed service records (storage/kafra/refine-UI/repair/divorce/reset/navigation); one record may cover several indexed call-site clues, e.g. the shared Kafra function

effective_static_map_flags.basis: map/flag declarations selected as effective in loaded static file order

runtime_map_flag_call_clues.basis: loaded-script setmapflag/removemapflag calls with a literal MF_ flag; call execution and conditions are unreviewed

runtime_map_flag_clues_with_literal_map.basis: runtime call clues whose first argument is a literal map name

source_reviewed_runtime_map_flag_behavio.basis: runtime map-flag call groups whose loaded-script control flow and conditions were reviewed; live map state is not observed

element_matchup_tables.basis: complete defender-element tables with four defense levels and ten attacking elements

weapon_size_adjustment_tables.basis: configured weapon damage size table covering three target sizes and documented weapon types
